title: Section 7.9 multi-scale stress and close-edge clutter
subtitle: Disk support, normalize_coords = True, recommended degree defaults, precomputed-kernel FFT application

config.degree_rule: r < 5 -> target d=5, 5 <= r < 9 -> target d=9, r >= 9 -> target d=11, capped to the largest feasible odd degree for the disk support
config.clutter_retention_definition: Mean of the two bar-edge peak magnitudes divided by the isolated single-edge peak magnitude for the same orientation and phase.
